decisions.rule_summary: Keep LE hidden target files inaccessible until scoring stage in controlled experiments.
decisions.evidence_of_benefit: Hidden-target discipline held across A/B/C and preserves experiment integrity.
decisions.evidence_of_risk: No direct risk observed in this run; only future enforcement drift risk.
conditions: Any pre-scoring LE target access invalidates experiment comparability.
decisions.reason: Core governance invariant validated in both WCD and WSA experiments.

decisions.rule_summary: Use nearest LE sibling as architectural skeleton for WSA family conversion when target is hidden.
decisions.evidence_of_benefit: Variant B improved score +51.78 over Variant A with zero final blockers/warnings.
decisions.evidence_of_risk: Initial Variant B verifier path produced copy blocker when sibling was used as direct reference.
conditions: Skeleton must be architectural reference only, not direct copy template.
Verifier-reference selection policy must avoid direct sibling-as-target copy trap.
decisions.reason: Strong quality gain, but needs guardrails to avoid skeleton-overuse and verifier-policy ambiguity.

decisions.rule_summary: Keep runtime-sensitive behavior fail-closed for static conversion runs.
decisions.evidence_of_benefit: All variants preserved 5 fail-closed items and avoided runtime claims.
decisions.evidence_of_risk: Risk exists only if future runs bypass fail-closed posture.
conditions: Runtime state changes require explicit hardware evidence artifacts.
decisions.reason: This rule directly prevents unsafe static-to-runtime overclaiming.

decisions.rule_summary: Require per-function lineage mapping for converted outputs.
decisions.evidence_of_benefit: A/B/C all emitted lineage artifacts enabling explainability and replayability.
decisions.evidence_of_risk: Lineage schema variation may reduce automation precision if not standardized.
conditions: Lineage coverage thresholds and schema notes must be recorded in validation.
decisions.reason: Lineage is foundational for governance and post-hoc auditing.

decisions.rule_summary: Do not directly use sibling skeleton file as verifier reference when skeleton reuse is the intended strategy.
decisions.evidence_of_benefit: Deviation documentation reveals this policy can prevent false blocker noise and misinterpretation.
decisions.evidence_of_risk: Current evidence is one incident; rule wording and canonical policy integration are still immature.
conditions: Formalize verifier-reference selection standard before promotion.
Validate on at least one additional non-WSA experiment.
decisions.reason: Important insight, but not yet stable enough for immediate platform-wide enforcement.

decisions.rule_summary: Use generic learning rules as governance overlays; do not expect automatic score gains.
decisions.evidence_of_benefit: Variant C preserved B-level quality while explicitly strengthening rule traceability and WCD-specific rejection logging.
decisions.evidence_of_risk: No measured score lift over B, so misuse risk exists if treated as guaranteed optimizer.
conditions: Learning overlays must report USED_CHANGED_OUTPUT vs NO_EFFECT outcomes.
PM review required when overlays claim quality improvement without measurable delta.
decisions.reason: Useful governance pattern with honest expectations about impact.

decisions.rule_summary: Reject WCD-specific MBHC/Class-H/SDW/DAPM behavior assumptions when converting WSA amplifiers.
decisions.evidence_of_benefit: Preflight extraction and Variant C rule-use logs show explicit behavior-rule separation and no cross-family leakage.
decisions.evidence_of_risk: Residual risk if future prompts omit explicit family-specific rejection lists.
conditions: Family-specific rejection list must be included in allowed-source and learning-rule artifacts.
decisions.reason: Critical anti-overfitting rule for cross-family transfer quality.

decisions.rule_summary: Treat compile/checkpatch absence as NOT_RUN, never as implied PASS.
decisions.evidence_of_benefit: Experiment artifacts preserved NOT_RUN honesty and avoided false production-readiness signals.
decisions.evidence_of_risk: If downgraded to optional reporting, PM could misread score/gate PASS as completeness.
conditions: PM summary must include explicit compile/checkpatch status line.
decisions.reason: Essential reporting integrity rule that generalizes beyond audio drivers.
